senses.gloss:
m. [युज्-तृच्] 
__1 One who yokes, joins, unites &c. 
__2 A coachman. 
__3 An exciter, instigator.

__1 A cord, rope, thong, halter. 
__2 The tie of the yoke of a plough. 
__3 The rope by which an animal is tied to the pole of a carriage; छेदने चैव यन्त्राणां योक्त्ररश्म्योस्तथैव च [[Ms. 8. 292.]] 
__4 A churning cord; ततो निश्चित्य मथनं योक्त्रं कृत्वा च वासुकिम् [[Rām. 1. 45. 18]], 19.
